## Do not disclose vulnerability details here

This public template exists only to redirect reporters. Close this issue
without adding technical details and use the private
[GitHub Security Advisory form](https://github.com/arrokh/rhasia-scret/security/advisories/new).
Read [`SECURITY.md`](../../SECURITY.md) for the supported process.

Never paste credentials, cookies, tokens, OTPs, Vault content, QR data, or
authentication links into a public issue.
